Made with real map data and honest estimates.

Places and categories come from Overture Maps. Distances shown are straight-line estimates, not walking or transit times. Check opening hours, access, and directions before going. The map uses © OpenStreetMap contributors tiles.

How plans are chosen

We use relevant place types, high-confidence records, and websites where available. Then we rank fair travel to stop 1, a short hop to stop 2, and variety across the shortlist. No ratings, paid placements, or invented hours.
